issue.title: dual boundary class can have a bad pair

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the bug with a test that fails before the fix and passes after it, but the PR's own test file test_fix.py still passes with the fix reverted, so it does not guard against this regression. The most important next step is to add or adjust a test that exercises a dual boundary pair with a good OCB and an out-of-range EAB index, so that it fails without the fix.
